commits.content:
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SSH VPN Tunnel Server — Kubernetes Manifests
#
# Deploy:
#   1. Fill in the gw_key secret value (base64-encoded private key)
#   2. kubectl apply -f k8s-deployment.yaml
#
# Requires nodes with:
#   - /dev/net/tun available
#   - kubelet --allowed-unsafe-sysctls=net.ipv4.ip_forward,net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding
#     (or sysctls set by the privileged container via entrypoint)
#
# ── NetworkManager (nm-ssh) — first-time / after pod restart ─────────────────
# nm-ssh runs as root with no TTY, so it cannot interactively accept a new
# server host key. After every pod recreation (new SSH host keys) run:
#
#   sudo ssh-keyscan -p 5500 -H 157.180.4.166 2>/dev/null \
#     | sudo tee -a /root/.ssh/known_hosts
#
# This is only needed when the pod restarts AND the ssh-host-keys PVC was
# deleted (i.e. the host keys changed). If the PVC persists across restarts
# the host key stays the same and no action is needed.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
    app.kubernetes.io/component: vpn-server

---
# ── ConfigMap — non-sensitive environment variables ───────────────────────────
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: ssh-vpn
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
data:
  # ── SSH ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SSH_PORT: "2222"

  # ── Tunnel Device ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # tun0 matches nm-ssh "Remote device number: 0"
  TUN_DEV: "tun0"

  # ── Tunnel IPs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  TUN_LOCAL_IP: "10.10.10.2"
  TUN_REMOTE_IP: "10.10.10.1"
  TUN_NETMASK: "255.255.255.252"
  TUN_MTU: "1420"

  # ── Routing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LAN_SUBNET: "169.254.1.0/24"
  LAN_IFACE: ""

  # ── NAT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ENABLE_NAT: "yes"

  # ── Auth (non-secret flags) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  ALLOW_PASSWORD_AUTH: "no"

  # ── Multi-user VPN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Add users here or via:  kubectl exec deploy/ssh-vpn -- manage-users.sh add <name> "<key>"
  # Format: one "username:ssh-pubkey" per line.
  # Each user gets tun slot N (1–253): server 10.10.N.2, client 10.10.N.1.
  # Leave empty to manage users at runtime only.
  VPN_USERS: ""

  # ── Logging ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LOG_LEVEL: "INFO"
  TUN_MONITOR_INTERVAL: "5"

  # ── Gateway Reverse Tunnel ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  GW_ENABLED: "yes"
  GW_HOST: "157.180.4.166"
  GW_PORT: "1122"
  GW_USER: "ansible"
  GW_SSH_KEY_FILE: "/etc/ssh/gw_key"
  GW_SSH_KEY_B64: "no"
  GW_EXPOSED_PORT: "2255"
  GW_PUBLIC_PORT: "5500"
  GW_BIND_ADDR: "0.0.0.0"
  GW_RECONNECT_INTERVAL: "30"

  # ── Go control plane (vpn-api) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  VPN_API_LISTEN: ":8080"
  VPN_API_PUBLIC: "false"
  VPN_OTP_TOKEN_TTL: "600"
  VPN_AUDIT_LOG: "/var/log/vpn/audit.log"

---
# ── Secret — SSH authorized key + gateway private key ─────────────────────────
# To populate gw_key:
#   kubectl create secret generic ssh-vpn \
#     --namespace ssh-vpn \
#     --from-literal=SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS="ssh-ed25519 AAAA..." \
#     --from-file=gw_key=/path/to/id_circle_k8s \
#     --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: ssh-vpn
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
type: Opaque
stringData:
  SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS: "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAILaQdRIqPxJpga6IGm00a+YM2251nv6XMSH32o3kJ2YI root@ssh-vpn-server"
  # REQUIRED: set to 'openssl rand -hex 32' output before deploying
  VPN_SESSION_SECRET: "change-me-generate-with-openssl-rand-hex-32"
  # REQUIRED: hex secret shared with Windows client OTPSharedSecret config
  VPN_OTP_SHARED_SECRET: ""
  # Paste the raw PEM content of your gateway private key (id_circle_k8s) below:
  gw_key: |
    -----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
    b3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAAABG5vbmUAAAAEbm9uZQAAAAAAAAABAAAAMwAAAAtzc2gtZW
    QyNTUxOQAAACC2kHUSKj8SaYGuiBptNGvmDNtudZ7+lzEh99qN5CdmCAAAAJijkH9ao5B/
    WgAAAAtzc2gtZWQyNTUxOQAAACC2kHUSKj8SaYGuiBptNGvmDNtudZ7+lzEh99qN5CdmCA
    AAAEClowIlE/32LMzjztooEK54+XuwgIy9Ne+FGXlLSS/6zraQdRIqPxJpga6IGm00a+YM
    2251nv6XMSH32o3kJ2YIAAAADmFuc2libGVAbm9kZTAxAQIDBAUGBw==
    -----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
---
# ── PVC — OTP provisioning tokens ────────────────────────────────────────────
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: vpn-tokens
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Mi

---
# ── PVC — SSH host keys (persist to avoid client re-trust warnings) ────────────
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ssh-host-keys
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Mi

---
# ── PVC — authorized_keys directory ──────────────────────────────────────────
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: authorized-keys
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Mi

---
# ── PVC — VPN logs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: vpn-logs
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi

---
# ── PVC — VPN user configs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Persists per-user tun slot assignments across pod restarts so users
# keep their IP addresses and slot numbers.
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: vpn-users
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Mi

---
# ── Deployment ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ssh-vpn
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
  strategy:
    type: Recreate   # Required — only one pod may hold the PVCs at a time
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
    spec:
      # ── Pod-level security context ───────────────────────────────────────
      # net.ipv4.ip_forward / net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding are "unsafe"
      # sysctls blocked by default in Kubernetes (require kubelet flag
      # --allowed-unsafe-sysctls). Since the container runs privileged,
      # the entrypoint sets these via `sysctl -w` at container start instead.
      securityContext: {}
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: regcred
      containers:
        - name: ssh-vpn
          image: registry.app.circle360.net/ssh-vpn-tunnel-server:v2.0
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

          # ── Container security — full privileges for TUN/iptables ──────────
          securityContext:
            privileged: true          # required for TUNSETIFF ioctl
            capabilities:
              add:
                - NET_ADMIN           # ip link, ip route, iptables
                - NET_RAW             # raw socket / iptables -j MASQUERADE
                - SYS_ADMIN           # mount, sysctl inside container

          # ── Environment — non-sensitive from ConfigMap ─────────────────────
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: ssh-vpn

          # ── Environment — sensitive from Secret ────────────────────────────
          env:
            - name: SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: ssh-vpn
                  key: SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS
            - name: VPN_USERS
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: ssh-vpn
                  key: VPN_USERS
                  optional: true
            # Empty/unused secrets kept explicit so entrypoint reads them
            - name: SSH_ROOT_PASSWORD
              value: ""
            - name: GW_SSH_KEY
              value: ""
            - name: GW_PASSWORD
              value: ""
            - name: VPN_SESSION_SECRET
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: ssh-vpn
                  key: VPN_SESSION_SECRET
            - name: VPN_OTP_SHARED_SECRET
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: ssh-vpn
                  key: VPN_OTP_SHARED_SECRET
                  optional: true

          ports:
            - name: ssh
              containerPort: 2222
              protocol: TCP
            - name: api
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP

          # ── Volume mounts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
          volumeMounts:
            - name: ssh-host-keys
              mountPath: /etc/ssh/server_keys
            - name: authorized-keys
              mountPath: /root/.ssh
            - name: vpn-logs
              mountPath: /var/log/vpn
            - name: vpn-users
              mountPath: /etc/vpn/users
            - name: tun-device
              mountPath: /dev/net/tun
            - name: gw-key
              mountPath: /etc/ssh/gw_key
              subPath: gw_key
              readOnly: true
            - name: vpn-tokens
              mountPath: /etc/vpn/tokens

          # ── Health checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["sh", "-c", "pgrep -x sshd && curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 25
            periodSeconds: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3

          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "256Mi"

      # ── Volumes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      volumes:
        - name: ssh-host-keys
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: ssh-host-keys
        - name: authorized-keys
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: authorized-keys
        - name: vpn-logs
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: vpn-logs
        - name: vpn-users
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: vpn-users
        # TUN character device from the host node
        - name: tun-device
          hostPath:
            path: /dev/net/tun
            type: CharDevice
        # Gateway SSH private key from Secret (mode 0600)
        - name: gw-key
          secret:
            secretName: ssh-vpn
            items:
              - key: gw_key
                path: gw_key
            defaultMode: 0600
        - name: vpn-tokens
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: vpn-tokens

---
# ── Service — exposes the SSH VPN port ────────────────────────────────────────
# Use type: LoadBalancer if your cluster has a cloud LB provisioner.
# Use type: NodePort for bare-metal / on-prem (clients connect to node IP).
# Use type: ClusterIP if you plan to expose via Ingress or a separate LoadBalancer.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ssh-vpn
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
  ports:
    - name: ssh
      port: 2222
      targetPort: 2222
      protocol: TCP
    - name: api
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
      protocol: TCP
